name: Kettlebell Overhead Carry
steps: Clean and press one kettlebell straight overhead until your elbow locks out with your bicep close to your ear.
Reach upward through the loaded arm, brace your abdomen and keep your wrist straight.
Walk forward with steady, controlled steps while keeping the kettlebell stacked directly over your shoulder and ribs down.
Stop after covering the target distance, lower the bell smoothly to the rack and floor, then switch arms.
tips: Keep your rib cage tucked down rather than flaring your chest or arching your lower back as you walk.
Maintain an active upward reach through a locked elbow so the kettlebell stays stacked over your shoulder.
